subject: Re: Pre-demo readiness — vendor intake & SSO requirements
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@harborhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Gabe Stone <gabe.stone@harborhealth.com>, vendor-intake@harborhealth.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-demo checklist / vendor intake items

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. Our security and procurement teams reviewed the agenda and have two gating items before we can run the live technical briefing with your SEs:

1) Completed vendor intake form in our portal (I attached the intake PDF for reference).
2) NDA executed via DocuSign (legal will not approve access without this).
3) SSO/IdP metadata and a short list of Redwood reviewers for access provisioning; we need an SP metadata XML and the email domain that will be allowed.

I know you offered to surface SOC 2 summary and an IDP guide — those would speed this up. Our team is traveling next week and wants to avoid a demo where access is blocked. If you can either complete the vendor portal fields or send the items to legal@harborhealth.com (DocuSign preferred), procurement will clear us to book the demo.

Can we tentatively move the demo window to the week of June 1st and confirm once intake is complete?

Attachments: Vendor Intake Form.pdf (PDF, 38KB)

Best,
Maya Patel
Director, Strategic Procurement
Harbor Health

> 1) Completed vendor intake form in our portal
> 2) NDA executed via DocuSign
> 3) SSO/IdP metadata + reviewer emails

I’ll coordinate internally. Ben (cc) is our SE who will provide the SSO SP metadata and an IdP integration guide; Priya (cc) on security will pull the SOC 2 summary and confirm any redaction we need.

- I will initiate the DocuSign NDA to legal@harborhealth.com today and drop the envelope link here when sent.
- Ben will attach SP metadata and the short IdP checklist by EOD.
- Priya will attach a SOC 2 one-pager and the data flow diagram.

Tentative reschedule: week of 2026-06-01 works from our side — can you confirm preferred day/time zones? We’ll hold until intake items are uploaded or the NDA is signed.

Thanks —

Phone: +1 (415) 555-0126

Hi Maya — Ben from Redwood SE team here.

Thanks for the intake doc — two quick asks from the SSO side so your team can provision access without back-and-forth:
- Preferred SP metadata: I’m attaching a ready-to-upload XML and a short integration guide. If Harbor uses Azure AD or Okta please tell me which; the metadata contains both ACS and EntityID fields, and I’ll provide sample claim mappings.
- Reviewer list: please add these addresses to the portal so we can give demo/test accounts: demo+harbor@redwood.ai, ops@redwood.ai. If Harbor requires named reviewers, provide the full names and emails.

I’m attaching: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary, non-sensitive), redwood-idp-integration-guide.md, and the SP metadata XML (inline in the guide).

Suggested demo window: Tue 2026-06-02 or Wed 2026-06-03 afternoon PT — we can hold a 60-minute slot and short 30-minute prep beforehand once the intake is cleared.

Attachment stubs: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 45KB), redwood-idp-integration-guide.md (Markdown, 12KB)

Let me know if you want me to upload these into your vendor portal directly; I can do that if you provide a temporary intake user or an upload endpoint.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Logan / Ben — appreciate the fast turn. Quick update from procurement/security: they require the vendor portal to show "completed" status and the NDA to be executed before they issue test accounts. We cannot proceed with the live demo until both are in place.

Action items from Harbor:
- Logan: please send the DocuSign envelope to legal@harborhealth.com (we requested named sig for contractual traceability).
- Ben: please upload the SOC 2 summary and the SP metadata to the vendor portal, or send them to vendor-intake@harborhealth.com so procurement can attach them to the record.

Procurement asked that we postpone the demo to the week of 2026-06-08 if intake is still in process next week. That would be preferable given our execs’ travel schedule. Please confirm once the upload and DocuSign steps are done and we’ll pick a firm date.

Thanks —
Maya Patel

Harbor Health
